data.title: Madonna tops Taylor Swift for MTV nominations
data.description: LOS ANGELES - Pop music icon ​Madonna scored the most nominations for the MTV Video Music Awards on Tuesday — ​four decades after the “Material ‌Girl” singer put the event on the cultural map with a headline-making performance.

data.title: New quake hits Spanish tourist city Granada
data.description: MADRID - A magnitude-4.8 earthquake caused cracks in walls and sent debris falling in Granada on Tuesday, lightly injuring three people, officials said, days after a slightly stronger quake hit the southern Spanish city.

data.title: Israel army inaction on settler violence exposed
data.description: JERUSALEM - The Israeli military is touted as the most powerful in the Middle East, striking targets deep into enemy territory. But for more than a week, Israeli troops have somehow failed to evict a small group of settlers sitting on rocks in the occupied West Bank.

data.title: British PM fooled by texts from fake Trump aide
data.description: LONDON - British Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Tuesday confirmed he had exchanged messages with someone pretending to be US President Donald Trump’s chief of staff.

data.title: Syria and US say Israel struck military air base in Idlib
data.description: DAMASCUS - Syria and the United States accused Israel of attacking a disused military air base in Syria’s northwest on Tuesday, as a monitor said the strikes followed a Turkish delegation’s inspection of the site.

data.title: Bangkok fitness coach dies after collapsing at Hyrox event
data.description: Bangkok-based fitness coach Leroy Saunders has died after collapsing and losing consciousness during the Hyrox Bangkok 2026 competition last Thursday, his family said on Tuesday.

data.title: UK PM says not embarrassed by hoax messages with fake Trump aide
data.description: LONDON - New British Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Tuesday confirmed he had exchanged messages with someone pretending to be US President Donald Trump's chief of staff.

data.title: Ukrainian jailed in Germany for Russian sabotage plot
data.description: BERLIN - A German court on Tuesday handed a jail sentence of one year and three months to a Ukrainian man for spying for Russia and helping prepare possible acts of sabotage.

data.title: Lingling Kwong wins both global and Thai beauty titles in 2026
data.description: Fans worldwide cast more than 22 million votes for the Thai actress in the global poll and more than 10 million in the inaugural Thai category.

data.title: Bangkok's New City Plan Set to Pull Property Buyers Back from the Suburbs, KKP Warns
data.description: KKP researchers say Bangkok's overdue city plan overhaul could trigger a "Pull-Back Effect", drawing buyers back from the suburbs

data.title: Death toll from Bangkok pub fire rises to 41
data.description: Two more people have succumbed to injuries suffered in a fire at a Bangkok beer hall last month, bringing the death toll to 41, authorities said on Tuesday.

data.title: Israeli businesses on Phuket in crosshairs
data.description: PHUKET - Provincial authorities say they are investigating complaints that some businesses operated by Israelis on this tourist island are refusing services to Thai customers.

data.title: ONE Championship: Phetjeeja out of kickboxing title defence with hand injury, sources say
data.description: ONE Championship women’s atomweight kickboxing champ Phetjeeja Lukjaoporongtom has withdrawn from her title defence against Antonia Prifti after suffering a hand injury in training, the Bangkok Post understands.

data.title: Times Square campaign rallies Thai support for Nene Royal at AGT
data.description: CP Group is taking Thai fan support for Nene Royal to Times Square in New York ahead of the Phuket teenager’s America’s Got Talent live quarter-final.

data.title: SET hosts “The 4th SET Annual Conference on Family Business”
data.description: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) invites business owners, next-generation successors, executives and family business advisers to “The 4th SET Annual Conference on Family Business”, held under the theme “Growth & Resilience in an Uncertain World” on Friday, Sept 25, 2026. The event will take place from 8.30am to 3.30pm at the Professor Sangvian Indaravijaya Auditorium, 7th floor, SET Building, Bangkok.

data.title: Retail and mixed-use boom pushes Siam land values to THB4m per square wah
data.description: Retail and mixed-use projects are reshaping Bangkok’s Siam Square and Pathum Wan, where land values have climbed to THB3.8–4 million per square wah.

data.title: Firefighters push to ‘encircle’ Belgian wildfire
data.description: SOURBRODT, Belgium - Firefighters launched a potentially decisive push Tuesday to encircle Belgium’s largest wildfire in a century, despite wind and rain hampering air support operations over the High Fens nature reserve.

data.title: Russia rebukes Japanese envoy in disputed islands row
data.description: MOSCOW - Russia on Tuesday rebuked Japan’s ambassador to Moscow over the disputed Kuril islands, which President Vladimir Putin visited for the first time last week.
